messages:
Hazel: Quick triage - planning to publish the launch post Thu 10:00 PT. Need owners for: final hero line, benchmark stat + 1-line methodology, a clean staging screenshot, a top-banner webinar signup that prefills email, HubSpot hidden fields + UTMs, and a legal quick-pass. Who can pick what up? :calendar:

Mina: Ill take hero + bench phrasing. Ill avoid absolutes and include a short methodology note. Will post two hero options in the doc.

Diego: Ill grab a screenshot from staging and export hero/social crops (1200x630 + @2x). Which route is the demo on?

Hazel: Use `app.redwood.staging/demo-stream` for the capture. Please scrub any org names and include the token meter + response pane.

Priya: Ill build the HubSpot form and wire hidden fields. Plan: hidden fields `lead_source=blog_launch_2026`, `product_interest=inference`, `orig_utm`, `company_size`. HubSpot prefill via `?email=` is supported; Ill add `email` and `orig_utm` to the reg link. Also will create smart list `launch_interest_2026`.

AssetBot: Uploaded hero candidates: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch_hero_set_v7.png and screenshot starters: https://drive.redwood/marketing/staging_captures/screen_3318882001.png. Recommend hero export 1200x630 for our template.

Leo (Legal): On the benchmark language please avoid absolute claims. Suggest: "Internal benchmarks on representative workloads show up to a 55% reduction in per-token inference cost (see methodology)." Include a 1-line methodology parenthetical mentioning sample size and baseline hardware. Also avoid terms like "enterprise-grade" unless SLAs are cited; use "built for production" or "enterprise-ready."

Mina: Noted Leo. Draft bench line: "Internal benchmarks on representative workloads show up to a 55% reduction in per-token inference cost (5k request sample; baseline: 8xA100; end-to-end cost measured)." Two hero options pushed to /content/drafts/launch_post_draft.md: A) "Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference economics." B) "Inference that scales with your application, not your bill." Which should be primary?

Hazel: I like A for the page, B for paid creative. Priya  can you incorporate hero variant in UTMs for A/B?

Priya: Yep - UTMs planned: `?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q3&utm_content=hero_a|hero_b`. For the A/B test Ill set `utm_content=hero_a` / `hero_b`. Also adding hidden field `lead_tier` and mapping to SFDC: company_size>=500 -> Enterprise AE queue, else SMB SDR. Flag any `product_interest=dedicated` as priority.

Diego: Screenshot captured from `app.redwood.staging/demo-stream`, scrubbed, cropped, and exported PNG + webp. Uploaded to drive and linked by AssetBot. No real org data included.

AssetBot: Also generated social crop 1200x628 and 600x314 teaser images.

Leo (Legal): Quick nit: replace any "industry-leading" phrasing if present. Otherwise bench language above looks ok. Keep methodology high-level (sample size + baseline hardware + end-to-end measurement).

Mina: Updated the draft to remove qualifying buzzwords and added the bench footnote. Pushed final copy to /content/drafts/launch_post_final.md.

Priya: HubSpot form created, hidden fields added, `email` prefill tested end-to-end, smart list `launch_interest_2026` created, UTMs wired and A/B mapping in place. Pushed SFDC mapping doc to the runbook.

Hazel: Final publish checklist - react with :white_check_mark: when done: hero locked, bench caveat added, screenshot uploaded, assets optimized, HubSpot form + hidden fields, UTMs/A-B set, legal sign-off.

Mina: Hero + bench done and pushed. :white_check_mark:

Diego: Screenshot + exports done. :white_check_mark:

AssetBot: Optimized hero and generated webp. :white_check_mark:

Priya: HubSpot + hidden fields + UTMs + prefill tested; SFDC routing documented. :white_check_mark:

Leo (Legal): Quick-pass approved with the bench language and removal of SLA claims. :white_check_mark:

Hazel: Amazing - scheduling for Thu 10:00 PT. Ill add the top-banner webinar slot (Tue 11am PT) with the prefill link and post the publish stub in #release-war-room when scheduled. Thanks team! :tada:
